description: target-system cost fixtures exist (oversized vs right-sized estate) for the dual-FinOps contrast
the oversized estate's monthly target-system cost is materially higher than the right-sized one (the gap a reviewer agent protects)
command: OVER=$(jq -r '.totalMonthlyCost' infra/fixtures/cost-estimates/estimate-oversize.json); GOOD=$(jq -r '.totalMonthlyCost' infra/fixtures/cost-estimates/estimate-good.json); awk -v o="$OVER" -v g="$GOOD" 'BEGIN{ exit !(o > g + 1000) }' && echo pass || echo fail

description: the agent-operating budget (Agent Run Ledger cost_usd) exists as a separate, ledger-tracked line — distinct from target-system cost
command: [ -f agentops/ledger.py ] && grep -q 'cost_usd' agentops/ledger.py && echo pass || echo fail
